raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

An EPLB rebalance stops serving for as long as it runs: 1.44-2.15 s per rebalance on a DEP2 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode (GB300, MegaMoE), and 3.7-4.5 s per rebalance on the MI355X prefill EP8 measured in #43754. The rebalance generator is advanced at the end of each forward pass on the thread that launches forward passes. It computes the placement in Python there, builds one P2P op per tensor per moved expert there, submits the transfers on the default communicator, whose NCCL stream waits for the current forward and whose completion the next forward waits for, and copies the staged experts into the live weights on the compute stream. The default single-chunk mode also wraps all of it in two `synchronize()` calls for timing.

`--eplb-rebalance-layers-per-chunk` spreads the per-layer work over passes but changes none of the things that stall a step: the placement is computed whole before the first chunk; each chunk's Python stays on the forward thread; each chunk's transfers still sit between two forwards on the compute stream; the staging-to-weight copies must sit between two forwards. The total GPU time is unchanged, split into 40/N pauses.

A first version of this PR moved the transfers to NCCL point-to-point ops on a side stream. On a DEP16 MegaMoE decode (16 ranks, 4 nodes) it hung within two seconds of the first rebalance and every rank died in DeepGEMM's `Grid sync timeout`: on SM100 MegaMoE is a whole-grid clustered launch that needs every CTA resident and is given all SMs but a margin of 2 (`mega_moe.py`, `SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_RESERVED_SMS`), so a rank whose NCCL kernel holds SMs cannot bring its MoE grid up, while the peer that would complete the NCCL transfer sits inside its own MoE kernel waiting at the cross-rank barrier for this rank. Any transfer that runs as a GPU kernel concurrently with that MoE kernel can deadlock it. This version moves the weights with no GPU kernel at all.

## Modifications

- New `eplb_async_migrator.py`. Each rank pulls the experts it needs from its peers' live weights through the Mooncake transfer engine with one-sided reads (`batch_transfer_sync_read`, the primitive the elastic-EP expert backup and the remote-instance weight loader already use), into one layer of staging buffers; DMA on the NIC and NVLink, no SMs, no sender participation, no pairing of sends and receives. `plan_layer_pull` is the pure planner: unchanged slot, same-GPU copy, free-rider on an earlier local slot, otherwise a read from a holder on the same node if there is one, spread across holders. The reads run on a worker thread; the placement and the plans run on another. The forward thread only enqueues the same-GPU copies, the staging-to-weight copies and the map update for one layer between two forwards, and polls.
- Lockstep by agreement, not by a pass count: once per forward pass during a rebalance, every rank contributes a flag to a one-element all-reduce on the world group's CPU (gloo) process group, first "my placement is ready", then "my reads for layer L are done". A layer is installed on every rank at the first boundary where the all-reduce says all ranks have it, so the maps for a layer switch everywhere at the same pass and no rank can route to a slot a peer has not filled. A peer's reads of layer L's live weights are therefore always complete before anyone installs L. The worker thread waits on the previous install's event before its reads so the staging buffers are free.
- `expert_location.py`: `ExpertLocationMetadata.compute_placement_by_eplb` runs the EPLB algorithm and, with static dispatch, the per-rank dispatch map on whatever device the counts are on, returning an `EplbPlacement`; `init_by_placement` and an optional precomputed dispatch map in `_init_raw`; `init_by_eplb` is the composition of the two. `compute_logical_to_rank_dispatch_physical_map` takes an optional `device`.
- `eplb_manager.py`: `_rebalance_async`, taken by `rebalance()` when `--eplb-async-rebalance` is set and this is not an elastic-EP post-scale rebalance; `on_model_loaded` registers the expert tensors and the staging buffers with the engine and exchanges session ids and addresses once, after `load_model`, before the KV cache is sized (`model_runner.py`). `reset_generator` drains in-flight work.
- `mooncake_transfer_engine.py`: the shared engine is initialized when `--eplb-async-rebalance` is set, so the flag also works outside PD disaggregation.
- Arg `--eplb-async-rebalance` (default off), validated in `handle_eplb_and_dispatch` (needs `--enable-eplb`, rejects elastic EP, warns that layers-per-chunk is ignored); docs row. The synchronous path and `expert_location_updater.py` are untouched.
- Tests, `test/registered/unit/eplb/test_eplb_async_migrator.py`: the planner's four cases on eight slots over two nodes; two gloo ranks on CPU drive the migrator through one rebalance with a shared-memory transport in place of the engine, rank 1's reads delayed so the agreement is exercised; weights and maps change only at each layer's install, and never before every rank is ready.

Costs: one layer of staging buffers per rank (about 0.5 GB at DEP16 for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash); the expert tensors registered with the engine once; one gloo all-reduce of one int per forward pass while a rebalance is in flight; NIC and NVLink bandwidth shared with the steps that overlap the reads; the worker threads share the interpreter lock during the placement.

## Accuracy Tests

Not yet run on a GPU. The planned check is GSM8K under rebalances on DEP2 as in #44847, async against the synchronous path.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not yet run on a GPU with this transport. Planned: DEP16 decode with EPLB on, async against the default single chunk, step times from the decode log around each rebalance, and the per-install cost from a trace. The previous NCCL side-stream version was run once on that shape and deadlocked as described above.

CPU-only so far: the tests above.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,381 @@
+# Copyright 2023-2025 SGLang Team

+# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+# You may obtain a copy of the License at
+#

+# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+# ==============================================================================
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import queue
+import threading
+import time
+from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+import torch.distributed
+
+from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location import EplbPlacement, ExpertLocationMetadata
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_device, get_parallel
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class LayerPullPlan(msgspec.Struct):
+    weight2buffer_copies: List[Tuple[int, int]]
+    buffer2weight_copies: List[Tuple[int, int]]
+    reads: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int]]]
+
+
+def plan_layer_pull(
+    old_physical_to_logical_map: List[int],
+    new_physical_to_logical_map: List[int],
+    num_local_physical_experts: int,
+    num_gpu_per_node: int,
+    rank: int,
+) -> LayerPullPlan:
+    lo = rank * num_local_physical_experts
+    hi = lo + num_local_physical_experts
+    node_of_rank = rank // num_gpu_per_node
+    weight2buffer_copies: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
+    buffer2weight_copies: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
+    reads: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int]]] = {}
+
+    for dst in range(lo, hi):
+        logical_expert_id = new_physical_to_logical_map[dst]
+        if old_physical_to_logical_map[dst] == logical_expert_id:
+            continue
+
+        src = next(
+            (
+                p
+                for p in range(lo, hi)
+                if old_physical_to_logical_map[p] == logical_expert_id
+            ),
+            None,
+        )
+        if src is not None:
+            weight2buffer_copies.append((src - lo, dst - lo))
+            buffer2weight_copies.append((dst - lo, dst - lo))
+            continue
+
+        src = next(
+            (
+                p
+                for p in range(lo, dst)
+                if new_physical_to_logical_map[p] == logical_expert_id
+            ),
+            None,
+        )
+        if src is not None:
+            buffer2weight_copies.append((src - lo, dst - lo))
+            continue
+
+        holders = [
+            p
+            for p, e in enumerate(old_physical_to_logical_map)
+            if e == logical_expert_id
+        ]
+        same_node = [
+            p
+            for p in holders
+            if (p // num_local_physical_experts) // num_gpu_per_node == node_of_rank
+        ]
+        candidates = same_node or holders
+        p = candidates[(dst - lo) % len(candidates)]
+        reads.setdefault(p // num_local_physical_experts, []).append(
+            (p % num_local_physical_experts, dst - lo)
+        )
+        buffer2weight_copies.append((dst - lo, dst - lo))
+
+    return LayerPullPlan(
+        weight2buffer_copies=weight2buffer_copies,
+        buffer2weight_copies=buffer2weight_copies,
+        reads=reads,
+    )
+
+
+class ExpertTransport:
+    def prepare(
+        self,
+        routed_experts_weights_of_layer: Dict[int, List[torch.Tensor]],
+        staging: List[torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def read_experts(
+        self,
+        src_rank: int,
+        layer_id: int,
+        slot_pairs: List[Tuple[int, int]],
+        staging: List[torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+class MooncakeExpertTransport(ExpertTransport):
+    def __init__(self):
+        from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import get_mooncake_transfer_engine
+
+        self._engine = get_mooncake_transfer_engine()
+        if self._engine is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "--eplb-async-rebalance moves experts through the Mooncake "
+                "transfer engine, which is not initialized in this process."
+            )
+        self._remote: List[Tuple[str, Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int]]]]] = []
+
+    def _register(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        assert tensor.is_contiguous()
+        ret = self._engine.engine.register_memory(
+            tensor.data_ptr(), tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size()
+        )
+        if ret != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Mooncake register_memory failed (ret={ret})")
+
+    def prepare(self, routed_experts_weights_of_layer, staging):
+        from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import get_world_group
+
+        local: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int]]] = {}
+        for layer_id, tensors in routed_experts_weights_of_layer.items():
+            descs = []
+            for tensor in tensors:
+                self._register(tensor)
+                descs.append(
+                    (tensor.data_ptr(), tensor[0].numel() * tensor.element_size())
+                )
+            local[layer_id] = descs
+        for tensor in staging:
+            self._register(tensor)
+
+        cpu_group = get_world_group().cpu_group
+        gathered = [None] * torch.distributed.get_world_size(cpu_group)
+        torch.distributed.all_gather_object(
+            gathered, (self._engine.get_session_id(), local), group=cpu_group
+        )
+        self._remote = gathered
+
+    def read_experts(self, src_rank, layer_id, slot_pairs, staging):
+        session_id, descs_of_layer = self._remote[src_rank]
+        descs = descs_of_layer[layer_id]
+        local_ptrs, remote_ptrs, lengths = [], [], []
+        for src_slot, dst_slot in slot_pairs:
+            for tensor, (remote_base, nbytes) in zip(staging, descs, strict=True):
+                local_ptrs.append(tensor.data_ptr() + dst_slot * nbytes)
+                remote_ptrs.append(remote_base + src_slot * nbytes)
+                lengths.append(nbytes)
+        ret = self._engine.engine.batch_transfer_sync_read(
+            session_id, local_ptrs, remote_ptrs, lengths
+        )
+        if ret != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"Mooncake batch_transfer_sync_read from rank {src_rank} "
+                f"for layer {layer_id} failed (ret={ret})"
+            )
+
+
+class AsyncRebalanceJob(msgspec.Struct):
+    layer_ids: List[int]
+    old_metadata: ExpertLocationMetadata
+    routed_experts_weights_of_layer: Dict[int, List[torch.Tensor]]
+    compute_placement: Callable[[torch.Tensor], Optional[EplbPlacement]]
+    logical_count_host: torch.Tensor
+    count_event: torch.Event
+    time_start: float
+    logical_count_device: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    placement_thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
+    placement_error: Optional[BaseException] = None
+    placement: Optional[EplbPlacement] = None
+    plans: Dict[int, LayerPullPlan] = {}
+    new_metadata: Optional[ExpertLocationMetadata] = None
+    layers_done: Dict[int, bool] = {}
+    layers_installed: int = 0
+
+
+class AsyncExpertMigrator:
+    def __init__(self, transport: ExpertTransport):
+        self._device = get_device().device
+        self._device_module = torch.get_device_module(self._device)
+        self._transport = transport
+        self._staging: Optional[List[torch.Tensor]] = None
+        self._cpu_group = None
+        self._install_event = self._device_module.Event()
+        self._install_event.record()
+        self._read_queue: queue.Queue[Optional[Tuple[AsyncRebalanceJob, int]]] = (
+            queue.Queue()
+        )
+        self._read_thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
+        self._read_error: Optional[BaseException] = None
+
+    def prepare(
+        self,
+        routed_experts_weights_of_layer: Dict[int, List[torch.Tensor]],
+        cpu_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup] = None,
+    ):
+        if cpu_group is None:
+            from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import get_world_group
+
+            cpu_group = get_world_group().cpu_group
+
+        layer_ids = sorted(routed_experts_weights_of_layer.keys())
+        self._staging = [
+            torch.empty_like(t) for t in routed_experts_weights_of_layer[layer_ids[0]]
+        ]
+        self._transport.prepare(routed_experts_weights_of_layer, self._staging)
+        self._cpu_group = cpu_group
+        self._read_thread = threading.Thread(
+            target=self._read_loop, name="eplb-async-reads", daemon=True
+        )
+        self._read_thread.start()
+
+    @property
+    def prepared(self) -> bool:

+            device="cpu",
+            pin_memory=torch.device(self._device).type != "cpu",
+        )

+        count_event = self._device_module.Event()

+            old_metadata=old_metadata,

+            compute_placement=compute_placement,
+            logical_count_host=logical_count_host,
+            count_event=count_event,

+        )

+        flag = torch.tensor([int(local_flag)], dtype=torch.int32)
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(

+        )

+    def placement_ready(self, job: AsyncRebalanceJob) -> bool:

+                target=self._run_placement,
+                args=(job,),
+                name="eplb-async-placement",
+                daemon=True,
+            )
+            job.placement_thread.start()
+            return self.agree(False)
+        local_ready = not job.placement_thread.is_alive()
+        ready = self.agree(local_ready)

+            raise RuntimeError("EPLB async placement failed") from job.placement_error

+    def _run_placement(self, job: AsyncRebalanceJob):

+        self.assertEqual(plan1.reads, {2: [(0, 0)]})
+        self.assertEqual(plan1.buffer2weight_copies, [(0, 0), (0, 1)])
+        plan3 = plan_layer_pull(old, new, 2, 2, rank=3)
+        self.assertEqual(plan3.reads, {1: [(0, 0)]})
+        plan2 = plan_layer_pull(old, new, 2, 2, rank=2)
+        self.assertEqual(plan2.reads, {0: [(0, 0)]})
+        self.assertEqual(plan2.buffer2weight_copies, [(0, 0), (0, 1)])
+
+
+class TestEplbAsyncMigrator(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        mp.set_start_method("spawn", force=True)
+
+    def test_two_ranks_pull_and_install_layer_by_layer(self):
+        shared = {}
+        for rank in range(_WORLD_SIZE):
+            shared[rank] = {}
+            for layer_id in range(_NUM_LAYERS):
+                tensors = []
+                for _ in range(2):
+                    t = torch.empty(_NUM_LOCAL, _ROW)
+                    _fill(t, _OLD_MAPS[layer_id], rank)
+                    tensors.append(t.share_memory_())
+                shared[rank][layer_id] = tensors
+
+        master_port = find_available_port(23456)
+        reader, writer = mp.Pipe(duplex=False)
+        processes = [
+            mp.Process(target=_run_rank, args=(rank, master_port, shared, writer))
+            for rank in range(_WORLD_SIZE)
+        ]
+        for p in processes:
+            p.start()
+        for _ in range(_WORLD_SIZE):
+            self.assertTrue(reader.recv(), "a rank failed; see its traceback above")
+        for p in processes:
+            p.join()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
